newsitem.title: USA: Landec Corp acquires Dock Resins Corp.
newsitem.headline: Landec Corp acquires Dock Resins Corp.

text.p: Landec Corp on Monday said it has acquired Dock Resins Corp for $12 million in cash and a promissory note plus $2.0 million in stock.
Dock Resins is a privately-held manufacturer and marketer of specialty acrylic and other polymers based in Linden, N.J. It generates annual sales of about $13 million.

Dock Resins' products are sold under the Doresco trademark to more than 250 customers in the United States for coating, laminating and adhesive products and for printing ink. The company owns a 24,000 square foot plant and has about 50 employees. No layoffs will result from the deal, Landec said.
